title: Bias-Mitigation: code and data for “Mitigating Algorithmic Bias in Multiclass CNN Classifications Using Polynomial Causal Modeling”
description: Code and data supporting the article “Mitigating Algorithmic Bias in Multiclass CNN Classifications Using Polynomial Causal Modeling” (submitted to Discover Computing). Contents: the Python notebook for data preparation, DeepFace emotion labelling, CNN training and prediction; the R notebook for causal bias detection and mitigation; the original prediction file multiclass_data.csv (5,477 test images) on which all results are based; and DeepFace emotion labels for the FairFace images. FairFace images are not redistributed; see the README for the source.
